origin_loss_weight_concentration.family_mass_definition: Sum of actual frozen origin-loss row weights within each selected source family; unselected rows have zero mass.
origin_loss_weight_concentration.limits: Not a count of independent observations, a bootstrap sample size, or a confidence-interval/sample guarantee. This diagnostic changes neither frozen loss weights nor confidence intervals.
origin_loss_weight_concentration.meaning: Weight-concentration diagnostic: the number of equally weighted families with the same concentration. Raw family count alone overstates effective weighted diversity when the original families retain half the loss mass.
